coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Overseas Employment Promoters need a licence and a security deposit, which can be forfeited; the public Overseas Employment Corporation also recruits; no joint liability with the employer.

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: Service charges are capped by the Rules; charging more is an offense.

coded.vi: Kontrak wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori pekerja, atau tanpa syarat minimum atau verifikasi
coded.vl: A contract is required, but only for some categories of workers, or without minimum terms or verification
coded.n: Registration with a Protector of Emigrants requires a work visa and an employment contract, but the law sets no minimum terms.

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: Briefing at the Protectorate at registration is required; formal training is not compulsory.

coded.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vl: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
coded.n: Registration requires contributions to the Overseas Pakistanis Foundation and a compulsory insurance policy covering death and disability; the Foundation repatriates bodies and supports families.

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
coded.n: Community Welfare Attachés are posted by the Ministry; the Ordinance creates no such duty.

coded.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
coded.vl: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
coded.n: Protectors of Emigrants and the Bureau act on complaints against promoters and forfeit deposits; offenses go to the Federal Investigation Agency and the courts.

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
coded.vl: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
coded.n: The Rules set a minimum age for women going abroad as domestic workers: 35 until July 2025, now 25; the rule applies to women only.

dec.n: Darshan Masih v. The State (brick kiln workers)
dec.pe: Families working in brick kilns in Pakistan were trapped by debts they could never repay. The Supreme Court said this was unconstitutional and ordered protection. A law banning bonded labour followed in 1992.
dec.pi: Keluarga yang bekerja di tempat pembakaran batu bata di Pakistan terjerat utang yang tak mungkin dilunasi. MA menyatakan ini inkonstitusional dan memerintahkan perlindungan. UU yang melarang kerja ijon menyusul pada 1992.

dec.pe: An Indian man was sentenced to death by a military court in Pakistan without his consulate being allowed to see him. The International Court of Justice said Pakistan must review the case.
dec.pi: Seorang pria India dihukum mati oleh pengadilan militer di Pakistan tanpa konsulatnya diizinkan menemuinya. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan Pakistan harus meninjau perkara itu.
